query:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (e.room_id, e.state_key)
                e.room_id, e.state_key AS "state_key!", e.content
            FROM events e
            WHERE e.room_id = ANY($1)
              AND e.event_type = 'm.friends.list'
            ORDER BY e.room_id, e.state_key, e.origin_server_ts DESC
